Sixteen comments

“Paddy Cronin’s” ~ another on in the repertoire of Johnny O’Leary

This is just one way with it, simple. It can and is also played in the keys of G & A Major… It’s another one I was surprised not to find here, but it has circulated and has gone through some changes, as happens, so I may have missed it in all the searching… Here’s a short example of other possibilities with this ~

K: Dmaj
|: E2 G F2 D E3 G2 A | BEE GFE BEE G2 E | ~
|: d3 c2 d e3 cBA | B2 E G2 E BEE GFE | ~

↳ Posted by ceolachan on March 19th, 2008.
